goal: Two distinct M15/H4 market mechanisms after CMA1, not closed XUA1/MBF1/CPF1 retuning, no generic commission wedges; OHLCV predictive gross may proceed with sparse bid/ask but no broker NET claim.
roleOfEURUSD: conversion route only, never a signal or trading candidate

mechanism.name: JPY_BASKET_0815_DISPERSION_RECOMPRESSION_M15_H4
mechanism.premise: Common JPY risk flow across three crosses temporarily leaves one cross mispriced relative to its two JPY peers during Tokyo-to-London repricing; next 45m may recompress.
mechanism.signal: if both peer completed 04:00–08:00 returns same sign and peer mean magnitude >=8bps, sell target if own 4h return minus peer mean>=12bps; buy if <=-12bps. No first/last bar from future.
mechanism.benchmark: same-clock same-instrument completed 4h momentum on IDENTICAL selected model events, same execution and costs
mechanism.invalidate: missing exact consecutive 16 native M15 closes in target or either peer, session closed, stale H4, or missing exact entry/exit closes

mechanism.name: NZDUSD_0700_H4_TO_M15_INTRASESSION_REVERSAL
mechanism.premise: Late Asian intraday price/volume reversal against completed Oceania 4h shock can persist into European preopen before London repricing.
mechanism.signal: last completed 30m M15 return absolute >=4bps opposite completed 00–04h H4 move absolute >=8bps; two newest M15 mean tick activity >=1.1 times previous four M15 mean; trade last 30m side.
mechanism.benchmark: same-clock same-instrument completed 00–04h H4 momentum, same modeled costs
mechanism.invalidate: missing exact M15 warmup, volume not observed, future bar, late quote, or forecast-evaluated clock outside 07:00 UTC

source.sourceReadback: encrypted original raw request+response protobuf, same-account double-sha, source hashes before any feature or forward outcome

selection.entry: next complete M15 close at t+15m, never same completed decision bar
selection.exit: entry close + fixed 45m for JPY and +60m NZDUSD, require all intermediate contiguous M15 bars
selection.scoring: simple log return in bps, model side versus same-event momentum, all empty weeks retained
selection.multipleTests: at most two fixed economic mechanisms, Bonferroni 2, no post-result retuning
selection.central: observed development paired BID/ASK median spread once + authenticated current-term 3USD/lot both sides converted via causal EURUSD M15 + 0.5 observed spread roundtrip slippage + 0.25bps hypothetical FX route uncertainty
selection.adverse: observed development paired BID/ASK p90 + authenticated current-term 3USD/lot both sides converted via causal EURUSD M15 + 1 observed spread roundtrip slippage + 0.75bps hypothetical FX route uncertainty
selection.stop: if no evidence gross uplift over matched benchmark or no credible cost support, mark exact configuration unpromoted without retrospective rescue
selection.priceBasis: authentic completed M15 close-only proxy, not historical matched bid/ask order fill
selection.financing: zero only for intraday clock windows demonstrably not crossing original 22UTC ordinary rollover; historical fee/rate continuity unverified
selection.fundedEurReplay: only after independent positive adverse model versus momentum plus fill/quote source and actual minimum-lot EUR300 joint financing evidence
selection.hard21: count only financed complete native ledger roundtrips across whole system and pre-eligible weeks
